scene.note: You move the shell from folder to folder with paths and write down the paths that work.

steps.note: Maeve wants last autumn's market notes, three folders down in the archive.
From the top folder the shell goes down through the archive, one folder inside the next.
Once there, the terminal can print the full path of where it now stands.
That full path goes after inside: in the notes.
Idris works inside orders and keeps needing the March invoices.
Orders and invoices both sit in the top folder, side by side.
A relative path is followed from orders, one folder name at a time.
The path that lists the March invoices from orders goes after back: in the notes.
Nobody can get into client proofs: the terminal just complains.
The shell splits a line at every space, and this folder's name has one.
Once the shell reads the name as one, the move into client proofs works.
The command that worked goes after proofs: in the notes.
